== Title ==
<span lang="ja">惑星防衛用イオン砲</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍の基地がある屋外位置に配備する。移動不可。同じ星の星系カードでの戦闘中、2フォース消費して大型艦を目標として起動できる。運命数を引く。運命数＋3＞装甲値なら目標のすべての武器はロストし、戦闘力＝0、航行速度＝0となる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">KDY製v－150地对宙重イオン砲。反乱軍の持つ地表固定兵器の中では最強のものである。数が少ないため、戦術的に重要な施設にしか配備できない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon]].

'''Lore''' — KDY v-150 surface-to-space heavy ion cannon. It is the strongest of the Rebellion’s surface artillery weapons. Because few exist, it can be deployed only at tactically important facilities.

'''Game text''' — Deploy at an exterior location that has a Rebel Base. Cannot be moved. During a battle at the system card of the same planet, spend 2 Force to fire at a capital ship. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 exceeds armor, all of the target’s weapons are lost, and power and hyperspeed become 0.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed subtype is 固定兵器. Game text deploys at an outdoor location with a Rebel Base and fires at a 大型艦 at the same planet’s system card. It uses 戦闘力 and 航行速度 for power and hyperspeed.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-planetdefenderioncannon-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon]].</ref>
